name: Craft Launcher
tagline: Install and update all thirteen Crafting Apps in one place
blurb: The open-source manager from ArtCraft: keeps PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, FilmCraft and the suite up to date.
description:
Craft Launcher is the unified manager and installer for all 13 Crafting Apps by the ArtCraft team.

Discover new releases, install updates automatically, launch desktop tools or open browser WebAssembly editions with one tap.

install.label: Download Launcher Release
install.command: git clone https://github.com/storytold/craft-launcher.git && cd craft-launcher && cargo run --release
